about.headline: Business Analyst at Flipkart, developer by instinct.

portrait.alt: Portrait of Pranav Deepak in a sunlit cave.

paragraphs: I turn gruntwork into scripts, dashboards into decisions, and most weekends into another rewrite. Slightly addicted to automation, unapologetically.

When I am not cohortizing customers or drafting engagement strategy, I am working with ML models or wondering whether the side project needs another complete do-over. From straightforward GSheet dashboards to graph neural networks, the working solution is rarely the complex one.
